Definition: of uncertain derivation; Thyatira, a place in Asia Minor:--Thyatira.
BiblicalUsage: Thyatira is a city in Asia Minor, home to Lydia the seller of purple and to one of the seven churches. In Acts 16:14, of the city of Thyatira. The place has its own entry in Biblical Places.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Thyatira matters because the gospel travelled through real places, and God met His people where they lived.
